set.body:
Parent epic: bd-01KXZZZWCEEDVD963AZA40FHE7

Objective:
Expose exactly the time-domain design geometry needed by canonical contrast moments while preserving fit ownership of temporal semantics.

Scope:
- Compile prepared design, one typed contrast, censoring, whitening, temporal nuisance treatment, and residual degrees of freedom into a small immutable PreparedContrastGeometry.
- Reuse the same ResponsePreparationPlan and contrast alignment rules as first-level fitting.
- Expose factored design quantities needed to construct effect and residual moments without materializing time-by-time projectors.
- Carry a TemporalPreparationReceipt describing row selection, whitening model, nuisance rank, contrast rank, estimability, and whether preparation was learned globally, per run, or within a training fold.
- Keep response-feature selection and canonical solving outside fit.

Acceptance:
Dense projector equivalence, contrast-basis invariance, nuisance-basis invariance, censoring/whitening parity, rank-deficiency rejection, and training-scope leakage tests pass on JVM and JS. No MVPA or multivar solver dependency is introduced into fit.
set.title: CCA 2: compile fold-safe prepared contrast geometry in fit
